name: coreguard_authorize
description: Bind a user's approval as a CoreGuard Consent Receipt (CGCR/1): the exact approved order bytes (intent + policy + declared submit payload) committed as an independently re-derivable receipt. nowSeconds must be a pinned unix-seconds string.

declaredTrace.description: the exact submit-order payload the approval covers

nowSeconds.description: pinned approval epoch (unix seconds) — never the wall clock

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGCR/1 consent record with pinned commitments over approved bytes.

callerContext.description: echoed caller context when supplied

name: coreguard_verify_consent
description: Verify a consent record's integrity and binding: recompute every commitment against the record's own approved bytes. Any tampered byte fails closed.

consent.description: CGCR/1 consent record as returned by coreguard_authorize

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Integrity verdict for the record's own bytes; fail-closed on tamper.

name: coreguard_verify_execution
description: Verify an executed order against a consent record, fail-closed: exact execution -> VERIFIED; any drift -> INVALID with the drifted field named (AGR/1). Single-use consents are consumed by first verified execution (process-local by default; file-backed host store via AC-CS/1 when supplied by caller integration).

trace.description: the executed order payload as observed

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Fail-closed execution verdict with AGR/1 risk report and consumption boundary.

name: coreguard_assess_risk
description: Classify one executed order against one approved authorization with the deterministic AGR/1 taxonomy. Not a probabilistic fraud score; VERIFIED ≠ SAFE.

consumed.description: whether this authorization was already consumed

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic AGR/1 risk report with classification, named violations, and taxonomy metadata.

name: coreguard_inspect_identity
description: Inspect CG-ID/1 identity split: recordId (who) vs contentDigest (what), with optional anchor facts and optional comparison to another identity. Offline and deterministic.

contentDigest.description: content digest as 64-char lowercase hex (no 0x prefix)

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CG-ID/1 identity view with anchor facts and optional comparison.

name: coreguard_build_attestation
description: Build a CGXA/1 offline execution attestation from a consent record and executed trace. No broadcast; no chain/network contact. nowSeconds must be pinned.

nowSeconds.description: pinned approval epoch (unix seconds) as non-negative integer or digit string — never wall clock

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGXA/1 offline attestation payload with attestation record and deterministic attestationId.

name: coreguard_verify_attestation
description: Verify a CGXA/1 attestation against its consent and executed trace. Offline, fail-closed; no chain/network contact.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGXA/1 attestation verification result with deterministic verdict and boundary-aware details.

name: coreguard_decide_outcome
description: Map a verification report to CG-OUT/1 outcome and authorization decision. ABSENT/NOT_CHECKED never render as BLOCK; VERIFIED ≠ SAFE.

report.description: verification report or bridge-compatible report object

receiptId.description: optional receipt id for profile reference

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CG-OUT/1 outcome, authorization decision, and optional profile reference.

name: coreguard_profile_reference
description: Create or parse a CG-OUT/1 profile reference. action='make' requires receiptId; action='parse' requires reference.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CG-OUT/1 profile reference result for make or parse actions with explicit action echo.

name: coreguard_consumption_status
description: Check/consume/release a receiptId in a consumption ledger. Default is process-local (this MCP process only). If storePath is supplied (or COREGUARD_CONSUMPTION_STORE is set), uses the AC-CS/1 lock-guarded file store, which is atomic across processes on the same host. Cross-host reconciliation is CG-SPEND/1 merge; on-chain anchoring is NOT_BUILT.

storePath.description: optional AC-CS/1 file-backed store path for same-host cross-process consumption (default: COREGUARD_CONSUMPTION_STORE)

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Consumption status with explicit ledger boundary.

ledger.description: process-local or file-backed (AC-CS/1, cross-process on this host)

name: coreguard_parse_x402_challenge
description: Parse and normalize an x402 payment challenge (HTTP 402 accepts). Offline deterministic validation only; no network contact, no payment execution.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Parsed x402 challenge with normalized accepts, issues, and boundary; no network call.

name: coreguard_authorize_x402_payment
description: Evaluate an x402 challenge against a local policy and produce an authorization decision. No custody, no broadcast, no payment execution.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: x402 authorization decision with policy issues and authorizationId; no payment executed.

name: coreguard_verify_x402_settlement
description: Verify caller-supplied x402 settlement evidence against a challenge. No network confirmation performed; evidence-only, fail-closed.

settlement.description: caller-supplied settlement evidence (network, asset, amount, payTo, txRef, status)

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: x402 settlement verification from caller-supplied evidence; no network confirmation.

name: coreguard_reconcile_payment
description: Reconcile authorization, settlement evidence, and receipt. Deterministic evidence check only; no external ledger/custody.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Payment reconciliation verdict across authorization, settlement, and receipt evidence.

name: coreguard_meter_agent_usage
description: Deterministically meter agent usage/cost events into an auditable total. No billing custody or external payment.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic agent usage metering totals and event digest; no billing custody.

name: coreguard_register_machine
description: Create a local machine registration record from a manifest. No external device attestation/TPM trust root verification performed.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Local machine registration record; external device attestation not performed.

name: coreguard_create_machine_task
description: Create a deterministic machine task record with terms/price/SLA conditions. No payment custody or physical execution guarantee.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic machine task record with terms digest and boundary.

name: coreguard_verify_telemetry
description: Verify caller-supplied telemetry evidence structure/digest and optionally verify Ed25519 signature when trust roots/public keys are supplied. Signature trust/physical-world truth not proven beyond supplied key material.

trust.description: Optional trust roots: { publicKeyPem } or { publicKeys: [{keyId,publicKeyPem}]|{keyId:pem} } or { keyring }

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Telemetry evidence verification result; signature trust/physical truth not proven.

name: coreguard_verify_task_completion
description: Verify task completion evidence against task record. Evidence acceptance is not physical-world proof; independent verification required for high-stakes actions.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Task completion evidence verification result; evidence acceptance is not physical proof.

name: coreguard_verify_delegation_chain
description: Verify delegation chain structure/continuity and optionally verify Ed25519 signatures when trust roots/public keys are supplied. Verification proves signatures over supplied payloads, not delegator identity beyond supplied key material.

trust.description: Optional trust roots: { publicKeyPem } or { publicKeys: [{keyId,publicKeyPem}]|{keyId:pem} } or { keyring }

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Delegation chain structural verification result; signatures require trusted roots.

name: coreguard_create_intent
description: CGCP/1 mapping: create an intent/approval request in a self-hosted file-backed control plane. Not a blockchain receipt and not payment execution.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGCP/1 intent/approval request record with mapping and boundary.

name: coreguard_issue_receipt
description: CGCP/1 mapping: record an execution receipt in a self-hosted file-backed control plane. This is a local execution record, not an on-chain proof or external payment receipt.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGCP/1 execution receipt record with mapping and boundary.

name: coreguard_verify_receipt
description: CGCP/1 mapping: verify a receipt record and the audit chain in a file-backed control plane. No external anchor/witness/on-chain verification is performed.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGCP/1 receipt verification verdict, receipt lookup, and audit chain status.

name: coreguard_check_limits
description: CGCP/1 mapping: evaluate policy/limit decision for an agent request in a file-backed control plane. No funds moved and no external IdP/KMS involved.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGCP/1 policy evaluation decision with mapping and boundary.

name: coreguard_revoke_consent
description: CGCP/1 mapping: revoke an approval, agent, or policy in a file-backed control plane. Local single-host revocation; no distributed propagation, no external IdP lifecycle.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGCP/1 revocation record with mapping and boundary.

name: coreguard_audit_transaction
description: CGCP/1 mapping: read and optionally filter the append-only hash-chained audit report from a file-backed control plane. No external audit/audit anchoring.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed in structuredContent.callerContext; never used as a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CGCP/1 audit report with chain status and optional filters.

name: coreguard_compile_policy
description: Compile a compact spending spec (limit, merchant/recipient/selector allowlists, currency) into a canonical CGEP/1 policy with a stable digest. Compiling the same spec twice yields the same digest; nothing is stored.

spec.description: policyId, name, maxAmountMinor (decimal string), allowMerchants[], allowRecipients[], allowSelectors[], currency

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Canonical CGEP/1 policy plus its digest and rule summary.

name: coreguard_explain_decision
description: Evaluate an intent against a policy and explain the verdict rule by rule, including the smallest single change (counterfactual) that clears the first blocking rule. Deterministic, no state written.

nowSeconds.description: pinned epoch seconds used for expiry checks

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Verdict, per-rule checks and a counterfactual.

name: coreguard_simulate_spend
description: Dry-run a batch of intents against a policy: allowed/denied per row, blocking rules, totals and counterfactuals. No approval, spend counter or ledger state is written.

inputSchema.description: Policy plus the batch of intents to simulate.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Per-intent verdicts and aggregate totals, marked dryRun.

name: coreguard_diff_policies
description: Semantic diff of two CGEP/1 policies by rule id: added, removed, changed rules, value-limit delta, strictness trend, and whether an agent must re-consent.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Rule-level diff with strictness and reconsent flags.

name: coreguard_generate_boundary_cases
description: Generate the cases that break naive policy tests: at the limit, one unit below, one above, unlisted target/recipient, closed window, wrong currency — each with the verdict the real rule engine computes.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Boundary cases with expected verdicts computed by the server.

name: coreguard_audit_server_manifest
description: Audit an MCP server manifest (server.json) before installing it: remote transports, unpinned packages, missing provenance, secret env requests, undeclared distribution. Returns a deterministic risk card.

inputSchema.description: The MCP server manifest to audit.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Risk level, findings with severities and the manifest digest.

name: coreguard_scan_tool_descriptions
description: Scan MCP tool descriptions for hidden-instruction and spoofing payloads: bidi overrides, Unicode tag characters, zero-width and invisible operators, HTML comments, and a fixed imperative phrase list — with offsets.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: CLEAN/SUSPICIOUS/DANGEROUS verdict with byte-level findings.

name: coreguard_check_lookalike
description: Check a merchant domain or package name for homoglyph, mixed-script and punycode impersonation of a reference: confusable folding, skeleton edit distance and explicit signals.

inputSchema.description: Candidate string and the reference it claims to be.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: IDENTICAL/LOOKALIKE/DISTINCT verdict with the signals behind it.

name: coreguard_diff_tool_surface
description: Diff two tools/list snapshots (before/after an upgrade) to catch rug pulls: added, removed and re-described tools, schema changes, description similarity, severity and whether re-consent is required.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Surface diff with severity and requiresReconsent.

name: coreguard_verify_evidence_bundle
description: Verify a portable evidence bundle against its own digest and each item's digest: detects edits, dropped items and digest substitution without any network or trust root.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: VERIFIED/INVALID with the computed digest and item issues.

name: coreguard_redact_receipt
description: Produce a shareable redacted receipt: sensitive fields (credentials, tokens, PAN/card, email, phone, keys) are masked, every redaction is listed, and both the original and redacted digests are returned so a holder can prove it is the same record.

reveal.description: field names or dotted paths to keep visible

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Redacted copy, redaction manifest and both digests.

name: coreguard_attest_batch
description: Commit many receipts with one Merkle root: domain-separated SHA-256 leaves, RFC 6962-style tree, per-item inclusion proof. Publish only the root; each holder keeps a verifiable proof.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Merkle root, leaf digests and inclusion proofs.

name: coreguard_verify_batch_proof
description: Verify a Merkle inclusion proof offline: recompute the root from the leaf digest and the supplied left/right path, and report the exact root mismatch if any.

inputSchema.description: Leaf, root and proof to verify.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: VERIFIED or INVALID with the recomputed root, the issue code and the proof steps used.

name: coreguard_freeze_agent
description: Kill switch over a CGCP/1 control plane: revoke the agent, reject every pending approval it holds in one audited operation, and report approved-but-unexecuted approvals as superseded by the revocation. Returns the chain head and every affected id.

inputSchema.description: Control-plane path and the agent to freeze.

nowSeconds.description: optional pinned epoch seconds; omit to let the local ledger stamp call time

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Revocation record, rejected and superseded approval ids, failure count and chain status.

name: coreguard_budget_runway
description: Project budget runway from pinned inputs: limit, spend to date, a pinned asOf and a spend window. Straight-line burn, remaining budget, runway seconds/days and the exhaustion epoch — no wall clock, no forecasting model.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Remaining budget, burn rate, runway and exhaustion epoch.

name: coreguard_detect_spend_anomaly
description: Flag unusual spend events with a median/MAD robust score (no training data, no clock): returns the baseline, the threshold for the chosen sensitivity, and each anomaly with its score and direction.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Baseline, anomaly list and the score threshold used.

name: coreguard_incident_timeline
description: Assemble an incident timeline from a control-plane ledger (storePath or an audit report): sequence-ordered events, detected sequence gaps and audit-chain status. Ordering comes from the ledger, never from arrival time.

inputSchema.description: An audit report, or a storePath when no report is supplied.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Sequence-ordered events, detected sequence gaps and audit-chain status.

name: coreguard_translate_receipt
description: Structurally translate a receipt to ACP, x402 or CGCR/1 and list exactly what the target cannot carry. Translation only: nothing is signed, verified or settled.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Translated object, loss list and source digest.

name: coreguard_emit_test_vectors
description: Emit deterministic integration test vectors for an SDK or gateway: baseline allow, amount drift, recipient swap, expired window and at-limit, each with the verdict the real rule engine computes.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Vectors with expected verdicts and how to run them.

name: coreguard_describe_surface
description: Return this server's capability card (or a one-line badge): version, transport, protocol, tool count, categories and the standing boundary — the record a directory, catalog or buyer can quote verbatim.

callerContext.description: Optional caller-provided trace/context metadata. Echoed back; never a cryptographic input.

outputSchema.description: Capability card with the server's own boundary.

name: coreguard_parse_iso20022_payment
description: Parse and validate a caller-supplied ISO 20022-like payment message (pain.001/pacs.008/camt.054 etc.) into deterministic checks and a digest. Offline; no SWIFT/bank network access.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Parse verdict, normalized fields, digest, checks.

name: coreguard_verify_cross_border_instruction
description: Verify a cross-border payment instruction against corridor/currency/amount/cutoff policy. Deterministic policy evidence only; no live compliance or sanctions screening.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Pass/warn/fail checks for the instruction.

name: coreguard_assess_fx_quote_risk
description: Assess FX quote evidence for expiry, spread, provider allowlist, and rate presence at a pinned nowSeconds. Offline; no market data feed.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: FX quote risk verdict and checks. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_swift_remittance_evidence
description: Verify caller-supplied SWIFT/remittance evidence against expected amount/currency/accounts/reference. Evidence only; no SWIFT network access or settlement finality claim.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Evidence match verdict and checks. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_bank_transfer_evidence
description: Verify bank transfer evidence against expected instruction fields. Offline evidence check; no bank API call.

inputSchema.description: Bank transfer evidence and expected values.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Bank transfer evidence verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_assess_sanctions_screening_evidence
description: Assess a caller-supplied sanctions/screening result packet for freshness, provider allowlist, and clear/no-match result. No live sanctions screening; evidence only.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Screening evidence assessment. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_invoice_match
description: Deterministic 3-way style match between invoice and payment evidence (amount, currency, payee, reference).

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Invoice match verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_generate_payment_compliance_packet
description: Bundle payment evidence into a redacted, hashed compliance packet for review/export. Local only; no regulatory submission.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Redacted compliance packet and digests. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_stellar_settlement_evidence
description: Verify caller-supplied Stellar settlement evidence against expected payment fields. No Horizon/network call; evidence only.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Stellar evidence verification verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_evm_settlement_evidence
description: Verify caller-supplied EVM tx/receipt evidence against expected chain, recipient, token, and amount. No RPC call; evidence only.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: EVM evidence verification verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_coredao_settlement_evidence
description: Verify caller-supplied Core DAO EVM settlement evidence with Core DAO chain-id profile checks. No RPC call; evidence only.

inputSchema.description: Core DAO evidence and optional expected values.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Core DAO evidence verification verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_pi_payment_evidence
description: Verify caller-supplied Pi Network payment evidence packet against expected values. Explicit boundary: attested/mock evidence only, no live Pi API/mainnet verification.

inputSchema.description: Pi payment evidence and expected values.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Pi payment evidence verdict with explicit boundary.

name: coreguard_assess_bridge_risk
description: Assess bridge transfer route risk from caller-supplied route/quote/proof/policy data. No bridge API call.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Bridge risk verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_assess_defi_position_risk
description: Assess DeFi position risk from caller-supplied snapshot (health factor, LTV, oracle age). No onchain/protocol call.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: DeFi position risk verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_web3_signature_evidence
description: Verify caller-supplied Web3 signature evidence structure and recovered/claimed signer match. No key custody or onchain call.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Signature evidence verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_stablecoin_reserve_evidence
description: Assess caller-supplied stablecoin reserve/attestation evidence for freshness and reserve ratio policy. No issuer API call; evidence only.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Reserve evidence verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_create_robot_mission_receipt
description: Create a deterministic robot/agent mission receipt binding mission, zone, budget, and time window to a policy digest. Offline; no robot control.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Robot mission receipt and digest. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_robot_mission_evidence
description: Verify robot/agent mission execution evidence against a mission receipt. Offline evidence check.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Mission evidence verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_assess_machine_sla
description: Assess machine/agent SLA from caller-supplied downtime/events against policy thresholds. Deterministic, offline.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: SLA assessment verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_assess_loan_application
description: Assess loan application risk from caller-supplied financial fields and policy (DTI, amount, tenor). No credit bureau/bank/regulatory decision.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Loan application risk assessment. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_collateral_packet
description: Verify collateral evidence packet for valuation, expiry, owner, and evidence digest presence. No registry/custody verification.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Collateral packet verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_assess_credit_line_utilization
description: Assess credit line utilization against a max utilization threshold. Deterministic arithmetic only.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Utilization assessment. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_verify_escrow_milestone
description: Verify escrow milestone release conditions: approvals, evidence, and release amount within remaining escrow. No custody/broadcast.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Escrow milestone verdict. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).

name: coreguard_create_incident_war_room
description: Create a deterministic incident war-room packet from incident metadata, events, and actions. Local evidence packaging only.

callerContext.description: Optional caller context echoed in response (never a cryptographic input).

outputSchema.description: Incident war-room packet and digest. (deterministic, caller-supplied evidence).
